records.name: Valorous Blaze
records.exact_visible_text: Meleys deals 300% DEF Fire Damage to an enemy and gains +20% Durability for 3 turns. When she's ENRAGED, all enemies also suffer a -15% Fire Resistance Debuff for 3 turns and she grants herself RENEW.

records.name: The Silent Provocation II
records.exact_visible_text: Starts the battle with 4 Coins in the TREASURY. When Gregor WOUNDS an enemy, he gains COUNTER for 3 turns and adds 2 Coins to the TREASURY.

records.name: Treasury Generator
records.exact_visible_text: Gregor spawns 1 Coin Gem every 5 turns. Begins on turn 1. Enemy side: Adds 1 Coin to the TREASURY every 6 turns. Begins on turn 6.

records.name: Treasury Generator
records.exact_visible_text: Tyrion spawns 1 Coin Gem every 5 turns. Begins on turn 5. Enemy side: Adds 1 Coin to the TREASURY every 6 turns. Begins on turn 2.

records.name: I'm Your Prince, Not Your Lord II
records.exact_visible_text: Start the Battle with 3 Coins in the TREASURY. When an enemy drops below 50% HP, Joffrey spawns 4 Coin Gems, and destroys 3 random Gems.

records.name: The Things I Do For Love II
records.exact_visible_text: At the start of battle Jaime strikes the Weakest enemy for 200% ATK Physical Damage and spawns 3 Coin Gems. When a team member withdraws from the TREASURY, Jaime spawns a Coin Gem and has a 60% chance to repeat this strike.

records.name: Drown In Your Blood II
records.exact_visible_text: All team members start the battle with a 200% Dodge Buff for 6 turns. When a BLEEDING enemy is defeated by any team member's Skill, afflict a random enemy with 3 BLEED then Osha strikes each BLEEDING enemy for 200% ATK Physical Damage.

records.name: Storm Of Silver
records.exact_visible_text: While Seasmoke has an ally marked as SEASMOKE'S FAVORED, the first friendly Skill used each turn will cause him to apply 1 RAID to all enemies, then grant his marked ally 75% of his current Stamina before he loses -75% of his Stamina.

records.name: Hardened Heart II
records.exact_visible_text: Cersei has an HP Guard at 25% HP. When activated, she deals +65% ATK Unnatural Damage to 3 random enemies and adds 3 Coins to the TREASURY.
